description_short: Analyze threat models, track scenarios, controls, attack events, and identify defense gaps.
description_long: Threat scenario tracking and defense-gap analysis. Supports: (1) summarizing a threat model document or tabletop exercise minutes — what the document itself states about assets, threats, controls and gaps; it does not construct attack paths or assign ATT&CK techniques the document does not cite; (2) building a threat scenario by hand from security controls and attack sequence events; (3) import_scenario, which loads an adversary_path_projector scenario seed as one scenario per projected path, or reloads a saved export_scenario document; (4) export_scenario, which saves scenarios in full so they survive a shell restart; (5) defense-in-depth gap analysis identifying steps with no implemented control, incomplete controls and easy bypasses; (6) markdown export of a scenario report. To project how a named threat actor would move through a specific architecture, use adversary_path_projector and import its scenario seed here.
author: Event Mill Contributors
